mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_replies (comment_id, user_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, created_at, status) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{replyUserId}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{createdAt}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM comment_replies WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_replies WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_replies cr INNER JOIN comments c ON cr.comment_id = c.id WHERE c.manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId} AND cr.status = 0
